AbathurMasteryPressurizedGlands.name: Pressurized Glands
AbathurMasteryPressurizedGlands.description: Increases the range of Symbiote's Spike Burst by 25% and decreases the cooldown by 1 second.

AbathurMasteryEnvenomedNestsToxicNest.name: Envenomed Nest
AbathurMasteryEnvenomedNestsToxicNest.description: Toxic Nests deal 75% more damage over 3 seconds and reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 15 for 4 seconds.

AbathurReinforcedCarapace.name: Reinforced Carapace
AbathurReinforcedCarapace.description: Increase the Shield amount of Carapace by 40%.

AbathurCombatStyleLocustBrood.name: Locust Brood
AbathurCombatStyleLocustBrood.description: Activate to spawn 3 Locusts at a nearby location.

AbathurSymbioteAdrenalOverload.name: Adrenal Overload
AbathurSymbioteAdrenalOverload.description: Heroic Symbiote hosts gain 25% increased Attack Speed.

AbathurMasteryNeedlespine.name: Needlespine
AbathurMasteryNeedlespine.description: Increases the damage and range of Symbiote's Stab by 20%.

AbathurMasteryProlificDispersal.name: Prolific Dispersal
AbathurMasteryProlificDispersal.description: Increase the duration of Toxic Nests by 45 seconds, reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds, and add 2 additional charges.

AbathurSlapathur.name: Slapathur
AbathurSlapathur.description: Abathur’s Basic Attacks deal 350% additional damage and Stun non-Elite enemies and disable Structures for 1.5 seconds. The same Hero or Structure can only be Stunned or disabled once every 6 seconds.

AbathurMasteryVileNestsToxicNest.name: Vile Nest
AbathurMasteryVileNestsToxicNest.description: Toxic Nests Slow enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

AbathurSymbioteCarapaceNetworkedCarapace.name: Networked Carapace
AbathurSymbioteCarapaceNetworkedCarapace.description: Using Symbiote's Carapace also applies an untalented Carapace Shield to all nearby allied Heroes, Minions, and Mercenaries.

GenericTalentCalldownMULE.name: Calldown: MULE
GenericTalentCalldownMULE.description: Activate to calldown a Mule that repairs Structures, one at a time, near target point for 40 seconds, healing for 90 Health every 1 second.

AbathurHeroicAbilityUltimateEvolution.name: Ultimate Evolution
AbathurHeroicAbilityUltimateEvolution.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

AbathurHeroicAbilityEvolveMonstrosity.name: Evolve Monstrosity
AbathurHeroicAbilityEvolveMonstrosity.description: Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity. When enemy Minions near the Monstrosity die, it gains 2% Health and 2% Basic Attack damage, stacking up to 40 times. The Monstrosity can be healed by Carapace and has the ability to Burrow to a visible location every 80 seconds.

AbathurMasterySpatialEfficiency.name: Spatial Efficiency
AbathurMasterySpatialEfficiency.description: Symbiote's Stab gains 1 additional charge and its cooldown is reduced by .5 seconds.

AbathurSymbioteSpikeBurstSomaTransferenc.name: Soma Transference
AbathurSymbioteSpikeBurstSomaTransferenc.description: Symbiote's Spike Burst heals the host for 64 Health per enemy Hero hit.

AbathurCombatStyleBombardStrain.name: Bombard Strain
AbathurCombatStyleBombardStrain.description: Locust's Basic Attacks become a long-range siege attack and they now lose health 40% more slowly.

AbathurMasteryEnvenomedSpikes.name: Envenomed Spikes
AbathurMasteryEnvenomedSpikes.description: Abathur's Symbiote's Spike Burst also Slows enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2 seconds.

AbathurMasteryAdrenalineBoost.name: Adrenaline Boost
AbathurMasteryAdrenalineBoost.description: Symbiote's Carapace increases the Movement Speed of the target by 40% for 3.5 seconds.

AbathurVolatileMutation.name: Volatile Mutation
AbathurVolatileMutation.description: Ultimate Evolution clones and Monstrosities deal 137 damage to nearby enemies every 3 seconds and when they die. Enemy Heroes hit heal the clone or Monstrosity for 100% of the damage dealt.

AbathurCombatStyleSurvivalInstincts.name: Survival Instincts
AbathurCombatStyleSurvivalInstincts.description: Reduce damage taken by Locusts from non-Heroes by 50% and increase their damage by 60%.

AbathurUltimateEvolutionEvolutionaryLink.name: Evolutionary Link
AbathurUltimateEvolutionEvolutionaryLink.description: Increase the duration of Ultimate Evolution by 50%. As long as the Ultimate Evolution is alive, the original target of the clone gains a Shield equal to 35% of their maximum Health. Refreshes every 5 seconds.

AbathurMasteryEvolutionComplete.name: Evolution Complete
AbathurMasteryEvolutionComplete.description: Increase Monstrosity's Basic Attack damage by 100%.

AbathurSymbioteHivemind.name: Hivemind
AbathurSymbioteHivemind.description: Symbiote creates an additional Symbiote on a nearby allied Hero. This Symbiote mimics the commands of the first, but does half damage and Shielding.

AbathurMasteryLocustMaster.name: Locust Nest
AbathurMasteryLocustMaster.description: Activate to create a nest that periodically spawns Locusts. Only one Locust Nest can be active at a time.
